name: The Agentic GTM Stack - webinar
thematic_brief:
Salesforce and HubSpot are racing to sell you AI agents. The harder question for go-to-market teams: who actually makes agentic GTM work — on your data, in your voice, inside your Microsoft stack?
Join Synozur CTO and former Microsoft 365 leader Chris McNulty for a working session on the agentic GTM stack.
We’ll start with a quick overview of the rapidly evolving world of agents and skills for GTM automation — and the role of MCP servers.
Next we’ll walk through the GTM fundamentals:
•	Messaging and Positioning Framework (MPF) & Brand Voice
•	Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
•	Competitive Intelligence (CI)
Next we’ll look at the burgeoning world of Cowork skills — repeatable, on-brand, compliant units of work — and how we adapt the same skills to run seamlessly across Claude and Microsoft environments.
Finally, we’ll look at how we extend our client GTM platform, Orbit, with Cowork skills and run it with clients every day. Then we’ll take you through one continuous showcase.
What you’ll see live — in four arcs
•	Market Research — a competitor teardown turned into a branded intelligence report in minutes.
•	Marketing — one insight becomes a week of on-brand campaign assets, in your voice.
•	Sales — an ICP becomes named, verified prospects, pushed straight to your CRM — with tailored battlecards to help shape your customer conversation.
•	Product Management — that same intelligence shapes the roadmap — and proves we build, not just pitch.
Who should attend
CROs, VPs of Sales and Marketing, GTM and RevOps leaders, and product leaders — especially at Microsoft partners scaling go-to-market without scaling headcount.
discount_statement: Attendees get a free copy of Synozur's AI in Marketing book later in 2026

name: TechCon 365 Chicago
thematic_brief: Land this story with urgency - AI is demanding change, companies are falling behind, and Synozur experts will be in Chicago to help: Change is the work. As organizations move from Microsoft 365 Copilot pilots to everyday practice, the hard part is rarely the technology — it is the people, the process, and the discipline to make new ways of working stick. That is the work Synozur does every day, and it is exactly what we are bringing to TechCon 365 Chicago, June 15–19 at McCormick Place South.
